items.docs:
AI-powered product selection endpoint.

Accepts arbitrary JSON for items and context, uses parallel per-item GPT calls,
and returns the zero-based index of the best item with reasoning and confidence.

Request format:
{
  "items": [arbitrary JSON objects, at least one],
  "context": {arbitrary JSON object, non-empty},
  "session_id": "optional string",
  "timeout_ms": optional int or null,
  "metadata": {
    "temperature": 0.5,
    "llmModel": "gpt-4o",
    "embeddingModel": "text-embedding-3-s
